comment: Phase 4 Theme 1 — memory protection deepening. Six commits that close the loop on 'protection is real' by making per-task PDs, 4 KB user mappings, graceful data-abort handling, and the deliberate-fault test all work together. F2 debugs the user_hello-hang regression that B4 surfaced as EXC:P.

tasks.title: Emit synthetic TASK_CREATE for kernel_task so audit stream is self-contained (closes J9 doc-gap)
Instrument prefetch abort handler to dump fault PC/LR/SPSR; diagnose user_hello EXC:P
tasks.result: Diagnosed: kernel heap (mm/memory.c MEMORY_REGION_HEAP_START=0x400000) overlaps user binary load region. Successful kmalloc inside ipc_send overwrites user code; PC=0 fault is downstream consequence. Filed as F2b. F3 unblocked; F6 blocked by F2b.

tasks.title: Relocate kernel heap out of user load region (0x400000-0x800000) to unblock F6 deliberate-fault test
Graceful data-abort handler: read DFAR/DFSR, terminate offending task, schedule next (replaces EXC:D busy-loop)
L2 page tables for 4 KB granularity user mappings on at least one section
Per-task page directories: task_t.page_dir_phys + context switch loads TTBR0 + per-task L1 allocation
Real B6 test: user-mode write to RO page triggers data abort, graceful handler terminates task, test continues
